+#define DECLARE_LOCAL_FUNC(func) \
+    .local func ; \
+    .type func, %function ; \

+#define DEFAULT_ATOMIC_OP_NAME(OPNAME, SIZE, MEMORDER) \
+aarch64_atomic_ ## OPNAME ## _ ## SIZE ## MEMORDER ## _impl
+
+#define DEFAULT_ATOMIC_OP(OPNAME, SIZE, MEMORDER)                       \
+        .align 3;                                                       \
+        .globl DEFAULT_ATOMIC_OP_NAME(OPNAME, SIZE, MEMORDER);          \
+        .hidden DEFAULT_ATOMIC_OP_NAME(OPNAME, SIZE, MEMORDER);         \
+        .type DEFAULT_ATOMIC_OP_NAME(OPNAME, SIZE, MEMORDER), %object;  \
+        .size DEFAULT_ATOMIC_OP_NAME(OPNAME, SIZE, MEMORDER), 8;        \
+DEFAULT_ATOMIC_OP_NAME(OPNAME, SIZE, MEMORDER):                         \
+  .xword aarch64_atomic_ ## OPNAME ## _ ## SIZE ## MEMORDER ## _default_impl;
+
+#define ATOMIC_OPS_START                        \
+        .data;                                  \
+        .align 3;                               \
+        .global aarch64_atomic_ops;             \
+        .type aarch64_atomic_ops, %object;      \
+aarch64_atomic_ops:;
+
+#define ATOMIC_OPS_END                          \
+        .data;                                  \
+        .global aarch64_atomic_ops_end;         \
+        .type aarch64_atomic_ops_end, %object;  \
+aarch64_atomic_ops_end:;
+
+#include "../../cpu/aarch64/atomic_aarch64.hpp"
+
+#include "atomic_linux_aarch64.s.inc"
+
+#ifndef __ARM_FEATURE_ATOMICS
+
+#define __ARM_FEATURE_ATOMICS
+

+
+#define ATOMIC_OPS_START                        \

+        .global lse_aarch64_atomic_ops;         \
+        .type lse_aarch64_atomic_ops, %object;  \

+

+        .type lse_aarch64_atomic_ops_end, %object;      \
+lse_aarch64_atomic_ops_end:;
+
+#undef DEFAULT_ATOMIC_OP_NAME
+#define DEFAULT_ATOMIC_OP_NAME(OPNAME, SIZE, MEMORDER) \
+lse_aarch64_atomic_ ## OPNAME ## _ ## SIZE ## MEMORDER ## _impl
+
+#undef DEFAULT_ATOMIC_OP
+#define DEFAULT_ATOMIC_OP(OPNAME, SIZE, MEMORDER)                     \
+        .align 3;                                                       \
+        .globl DEFAULT_ATOMIC_OP_NAME(OPNAME, SIZE, MEMORDER);          \
+        .hidden DEFAULT_ATOMIC_OP_NAME(OPNAME, SIZE, MEMORDER);         \
+        .type DEFAULT_ATOMIC_OP_NAME(OPNAME, SIZE, MEMORDER), %object;  \
+        .size DEFAULT_ATOMIC_OP_NAME(OPNAME, SIZE, MEMORDER), 8;        \
+DEFAULT_ATOMIC_OP_NAME(OPNAME, SIZE, MEMORDER):                         \
+  .xword lse_aarch64_atomic_ ## OPNAME ## _ ## SIZE ## MEMORDER ## _default_impl;
+
+#undef DECLARE_LOCAL_FUNC
+#define DECLARE_LOCAL_FUNC(func)                \
+    .local lse_  ## func ;                      \
+    .type lse_ ## func, %function ;             \
+    lse_ ##func
+

+#undef ATOMIC_OP

+#ifdef __ARM_FEATURE_ATOMICS
+#define ATOMIC_OP(LOAD, OP, STORE, SZ, MEMBAR, LSEOP)    \
+        hint    #0x22 /* bti c */               ;\
+        LSEOP SZ ## 1, SZ ## 2, [x0]            ;\
+        MEMBAR                                  ;\
+        mov     SZ ## 0, SZ ## 2                ;\
+        ret
+#else
+#define ATOMIC_OP(LOAD, OP, STORE, SZ, MEMBAR, LSEOP)    \
+        hint    #0x22 /* bti c */               ;\
+        prfm    pstl1strm, [x0]                 ;\
+0:      LOAD    SZ ## 2, [x0]                   ;\
+        OP      SZ ## 8, SZ ## 2, SZ ## 1       ;\
+        STORE   w9, SZ ## 8, [x0]               ;\
+        cbnz    w9, 0b                          ;\
+        MEMBAR                                  ;\
+        mov     SZ ## 0, SZ ## 2                ;\
+        ret
+#endif
+
+#define DMB                              ;\
+        dmb ish                          ;
+
+        .align 5
+DECLARE_LOCAL_FUNC(aarch64_atomic_fetch_add_8_default_impl):
+        ATOMIC_OP(ldaxr, add, stlxr, x, DMB, ldaddal)
+        .align 5
+DECLARE_LOCAL_FUNC(aarch64_atomic_fetch_add_4_default_impl):
+        ATOMIC_OP(ldaxr, add, stlxr, w, DMB, ldaddal)
+
+        .align 5
+DECLARE_LOCAL_FUNC(aarch64_atomic_fetch_add_8_relaxed_default_impl):
+        ATOMIC_OP(ldxr, add, stxr, x, , ldadd)
+        .align 5
+DECLARE_LOCAL_FUNC(aarch64_atomic_fetch_add_4_relaxed_default_impl):
+        ATOMIC_OP(ldxr, add, stxr, w, , ldadd)
+
+
+#undef ATOMIC_OP
+
+#ifdef __ARM_FEATURE_ATOMICS
+#define ATOMIC_OP(LOAD, STORE, SZ, LSEOP)        \
+        hint    #0x22 /* bti c */               ;\
+        LSEOP SZ ## 1, SZ ## 2, [x0]            ;\
+        dmb     ish                             ;\
+        mov     SZ ## 0, SZ ## 2                ;\
+        ret
+#else
+#define ATOMIC_OP(LOAD, STORE, SZ, LSEOP)        \
+        hint    #0x22 /* bti c */               ;\
+        prfm    pstl1strm, [x0]                 ;\
+0:      LOAD    SZ ## 2, [x0]                   ;\
+        STORE   w8, SZ ## 1, [x0]               ;\
+        cbnz    w8, 0b                          ;\
+        dmb     ish                             ;\
+        mov     SZ ## 0, SZ ## 2                ;\
+        ret
+#endif
+
+        .align 5
+DECLARE_LOCAL_FUNC(aarch64_atomic_xchg_1_default_impl):
+        ATOMIC_OP(ldaxrb, stlxrb, w, swpalb)
+DECLARE_LOCAL_FUNC(aarch64_atomic_xchg_4_default_impl):
+        ATOMIC_OP(ldaxr, stlxr, w, swpal)
+DECLARE_LOCAL_FUNC(aarch64_atomic_xchg_8_default_impl):
+        ATOMIC_OP(ldaxr, stlxr, x, swpal)
+
+#undef ATOMIC_OP
+#ifdef __ARM_FEATURE_ATOMICS
+#define ATOMIC_OP(LOAD, STORE, SZ, CMP, MEMBAR, LSEOP) \
+        hint    #0x22 /* bti c */               ;\
+        mov     SZ ## 3, SZ ## 1                ;\
+        LSEOP   SZ ## 3, SZ ## 2, [x0]          ;\
+        MEMBAR                                  ;\
+        mov     SZ ## 0, SZ ## 3                ;\
+        ret
+#else
+#define ATOMIC_OP(LOAD, STORE, SZ, CMP, MEMBAR, LSEOP) \
+        hint    #0x22 /* bti c */               ;\
+        MEMBAR                                  ;\
+        prfm    pstl1strm, [x0]                 ;\
+0:      LOAD    SZ ## 3, [x0]                   ;\
+        CMP                                     ;\
+        STORE   w8, SZ ## 2, [x0]               ;\
+        cbnz    w8, 0b                          ;\
+1:      MEMBAR                                  ;\
+        mov     SZ ## 0, SZ ## 3                ;\
+        ret
+#endif
+
+#define CMPB                              \
+        eor     w8, w3, w1               ;\
+        tst     x8, #0xff                ;\
+        b.ne    1f                       ;
+#define CMPW                             ;\
+        cmp     w3, w1                   ;\
+        b.ne    1f                       ;
+#define CMPX                             ;\
+        cmp     x3, x1                   ;\
+        b.ne    1f
+
+        .align 5
+DECLARE_LOCAL_FUNC(aarch64_atomic_cmpxchg_1_default_impl):
+        ATOMIC_OP(ldxrb, stxrb, w, CMPB, DMB, casalb)
+        .align 5
+DECLARE_LOCAL_FUNC(aarch64_atomic_cmpxchg_4_default_impl):
+        ATOMIC_OP(ldxr, stxr, w, CMPW, DMB, casal)
+        .align 5
+DECLARE_LOCAL_FUNC(aarch64_atomic_cmpxchg_8_default_impl):
+        ATOMIC_OP(ldxr, stxr, x, CMPX, DMB, casal)
+
+        .align 5
+DECLARE_LOCAL_FUNC(aarch64_atomic_cmpxchg_4_release_default_impl):
+        ATOMIC_OP(ldxr, stlxr, w, CMPW, , casl)
+        .align 5
+DECLARE_LOCAL_FUNC(aarch64_atomic_cmpxchg_8_release_default_impl):
+        ATOMIC_OP(ldxr, stlxr, x, CMPX, , casl)
+
+       .align 5
+DECLARE_LOCAL_FUNC(aarch64_atomic_cmpxchg_4_seq_cst_default_impl):
+        ATOMIC_OP(ldaxr, stlxr, w, CMPW, , casl)
+        .align 5
+DECLARE_LOCAL_FUNC(aarch64_atomic_cmpxchg_8_seq_cst_default_impl):
+        ATOMIC_OP(ldaxr, stlxr, x, CMPX, , casl)

+        .align 5

+        .align 5

+        ATOMIC_OP(ldxr, stxr, w, CMPW, , casl)
+        .align 5
+DECLARE_LOCAL_FUNC(aarch64_atomic_cmpxchg_8_relaxed_default_impl):
+        ATOMIC_OP(ldxr, stxr, x, CMPX, , casl)
